items.title: Bob Cranshaw interviewed by Michael Woods, New York City, New York, October 18, 1995
items.q: I remember being wiped out by Oscar Peterson and the next group that came to the London House was Jonah Jones. And Jonah Jones caught it, cause we took out Oscar.

ctx.x: It’s okay to get wiped out by people like that. © Fillius Jazz Archive -11-

But now the next group that came in, I remember being wiped out by Oscar Peterson and the next group that came to the London House was Jonah Jones. And Jonah Jones caught it, cause we took out Oscar. Jonah and the group had to be playing. Whoever came in next, would really be playing other than that. Because we were wounded you know. We were animals and we were wounded so we needed to come back. But it was a nice pride and we looked to get washed, and we knew we were like the “Junior Oscar Peterson” because…
So it’s a voice for you? The bass is a voice, isn’t it?
